claimsBoundary: Functional PASS is copied only from the source report.

Its three earned answers and first reward must not be presented as the continuation of the rhythm or real-onboarding profiles. Its raw report has no standalone profileId, sourceStable, browserClosed or humanN fields; absence is retained.
